subject: pharmacology
title: Immunosuppressants I: Cyclosporine, Tacrolimus, mTOR Inhibitors, Mycophenolate and TPMT

steps.tx: **Cyclosporine** binds cyclophilin and **tacrolimus** binds FKBP, both complexes strangling **calcineurin** so NFAT cannot switch on interleukin 2 and T cell activation stalls at its first sentence. Transplant rejection prophylaxis was rebuilt on this blockade, with tacrolimus generally the more potent and diabetogenic, cyclosporine the more hypertensive and lipid raising, both monitored by trough blood levels because their therapeutic windows are genuinely narrow.
steps.say: Two drugs, two binding proteins, one strangled phosphatase: calcineurin is the transplant era's hinge.

vis.alt: Immunosuppressant sites of action on T cell activation diagram
vis.caption: Immunosuppressant sites on T cell activation, calcineurin at the IL 2 switch.

steps.tx: **Nephrotoxicity** is the calcineurin class ceiling: afferent arteriolar vasoconstriction acutely (dose and level related, reversible early) and striped interstitial fibrosis chronically, compounded by every other renal insult on the transplant chart (aminoglycosides, NSAIDs, amphotericin). Creatinine trends, level discipline and biopsy arbitration between rejection and drug injury are the lifelong clinic rhythm this toxicity writes.
steps.say: The drug that saves the graft injures it slowly; biopsy arbitrates rejection versus drug.

left.title: Acute injury
points: Level related, reversible with dose cuts

right.title: Chronic injury
points: Striped interstitial fibrosis and arteriolar hyalinosis

steps.tx: Cyclosporine's cosmetic and metabolic ledger is examination beloved: **gingival hyperplasia** (shared with phenytoin and calcium blockers from earlier lessons, one differential triad), hirsutism, hyperlipidaemia, hyperuricaemia with gout, hypertension, and glucose intolerance, against tacrolimus's alopecia instead of hirsutism, stronger diabetogenicity (post transplant diabetes), tremor and rare posterior reversible encephalopathy. The two ledgers decide swaps between them.
steps.say: Gums, hair, sugar and pressure sort the twins; swaps are prescribed by ledger, not habit.

steps.tx: **Sirolimus** and **everolimus** block mTOR downstream of interleukin 2's receptor, halting proliferation signal three rather than cytokine production, serving transplant regimens (calcineurin sparing), drug eluting coronary stents, tuberous sclerosis and oncology niches, billing mouth ulcers, pneumonitis, poor wound healing (fenced around surgery), hyperlipidaemia, proteinuria and marrow suppression monitored by levels of their own.
steps.say: mTOR blockers stop the proliferation signal, spare calcineurin and bill wounds, lungs and lips.

steps.tx: **Mycophenolate mofetil** blocks inosine monophosphate dehydrogenase, the de novo purine synthesis lymphocytes uniquely depend on, making it transplantation's antimetabolite anchor and lupus nephritis's co standard, billing diarrhoea and enteropathy (dose split and enteric coated mycophenolate answer), marrow suppression and teratogenicity with mandatory pregnancy prevention programmes. Its selectivity is metabolic, not targeted, which is why gut shares the bill.
steps.say: Mycophenolate starves lymphocytes of purines they cannot scavenge; the gut pays the selectivity gap.

left.title: Mycophenolate design
points: Enteric coated form for gut intolerance

right.title: Mycophenolate rules
points: Diarrhoea and colitis mimics graft versus host
Antacids and bile resins cut absorption

steps.tx: **TPMT** testing governs azathioprine from the mercaptopurine lesson: poor metabolisers (about 1 in 300) accumulate thioguanine nucleotides into life threatening marrow failure on standard doses, intermediate activity halves starting doses, and NUDT15 variants extend the rule to Asian ancestry. Where testing is unavailable, slow titration with blood counts is the older discipline. The same gene guards oncology's mercaptopurine, one test serving two buildings.
steps.say: One TPMT result guards rheumatology, gastroenterology, transplant and leukaemia prescriptions alike.

nodes.label: TPMT (and NUDT15 where indicated) before thiopurine
Poor: avoid or tiny dose; intermediate: halve start
Allopurinol co therapy: cut thiopurine by two thirds

steps.tx: **Calcineurin interactions** run through CYP3A4 and P glycoprotein with transplant stakes: azoles, macrolides and grapefruit raise levels into nephrotoxicity, rifampicin and enzyme inducing antiseizure drugs crash levels into rejection, and St John's wort has rejected grafts by stealth. Every new prescription in a transplant patient is a level event, checked and rechecked after changes, the interaction web with organs at stake.
steps.say: In transplant patients every new drug is a calcineurin level event; grapefruit has rejected kidneys.

steps.tx: **Regimen architecture** assembles the module: induction (basiliximab or antithymocyte globulin from the next lesson) plus maintenance triple therapy (calcineurin inhibitor, mycophenolate or azathioprine, tapering steroid), infection prophylaxis calendars (co trimoxazole, valganciclovir by donor recipient serology), malignancy and metabolic survivorship, and therapeutic drug monitoring as the discipline holding it together.
steps.say: Induction, triple maintenance, prophylaxis calendars, level discipline: the architecture in one sentence.
